'''Ral''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Hutt counselor|counselor]] who worked for the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], Ral had [[Ghitsa Dogder]] kidnapped and [[Torture/Legends|interrogated]] to learn about [[Durga Besadii Tai]]'s investments in [[Orko SkyMine Asteroid Processing Corporation|Orko Skymine]]. What he hadn't counted on was the arrival of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kyp Durron]] and Ghitsa's partner [[Fenig Nabon]] who rescued Ghitsa and cut their way out of the [[Rook (720 light freighter)|''Rook'']] with Kyp's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. After ''Rook'' tried to escape, it was destroyed by hull breach when entering the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] atmosphere despite of Ghitsa's warning.
